gate_angus.text: Road closed at Stonehaven. Resurfacing, apparently, though I have not seen a single steamroller.
It reopens once the Keeper at the Inverness ice rink has had a word with you. Don't ask me how I know. I only hold the cones.

ang_smokie.text: Two haddock tied by the tails, hung over a barrel fire. That is it. That is the secret. The other secret is not to tell the tourists it is that simple.
Mòran taing for asking. Most people just ask where the chip shop is.

ang_birder.text: Fowlsheugh is a good wall of birds. Kittiwakes, guillemots, razorbills. If anyone says the puffin is hiding, they are lying. It is just thinking.
A kittiwake is named for its own call. Whoever came up with the name had an easy day.

ang_honours.text: The Honours of Scotland were hidden from Cromwell here, carried out under the besiegers' noses, and buried in a kirk. The story is better than any film they have made of it.
A woman in the kirkyard hid them, they say, in plain sight, with a basket of flax. That is the sort of bravery you do not put in a poster.

ang_lifeboat.text: I am on the crew. Two hours' warning, usually. The pager goes at the worst moment. It is always the worst moment.
The sea off Angus has taken ships for a very long time. We have been taking them back out, a little more often, ever since.
